title: SOM v0.3.1 — delivery.media_available payload
description: Operational media-arrival event on som.delivery.* (v0.3.1 Proposal §3.3). The TAMS junction: TAMS posts media-available events to the SOM bus. Source re-key (29 Jun, lazy-consensus to 1 Jul): media referenced the same Source-centric way as the asset leg (media_refs[]) so the two legs do not drift — Source URI (tams://store/id) + optional time range, not flow_id. Normalised: no story_id copy; resolve the story through asset_id.

source.description: Fully-qualified TAMS Source URI — tams://store/id; resolves across remote/second-hand stores. Replaces flow_id (Source re-key 29 Jun).

time_range.description: Optional TAMS time range, or list of ranges, onto the Source.

timerange.description: TAMS timerange — bracketed inclusive/exclusive over seconds:nanoseconds timestamps (e.g. [0:500000000_1:0) ). Open-ended start or end permitted.
